issues.on_page: School Nutrition Fund reported in 'Other Governmental Funds' (Exhibits C/D, p3-5); fund balance 'Assigned for: School nutrition program'
issues.issue: The extractor rules list school nutrition among business-type funds. Here the report presents it as a governmental fund, so 'governmental' can be defended (and keeps the Exhibit D totals intact), but a person should confirm it.

issues.on_page: Other student support 1,409,820.85 (single line, Other Governmental Funds column)
issues.issue: The split uses the Activities and School Nutrition fund schedule totals, which tie exactly to the statement line. The statement prints no breakdown of the line itself, so this is a judgment call under the split_from rule.

issues.on_page: Debt Service 304,490.03 (p5); Special Building Fund Redemption of principal 289,499.62 / Interest on long-term debt 14,990.41 (p16)
issues.issue: The split uses the Special Building Fund schedule. It ties exactly and is defensible, but the statement line itself is not broken down.

issues.extracted: Exhibit N Capital Assets lines 150,000.00 (Vehicle Operation, p24) and 100,000.00 (Building Improvements, p25) kept as spending, offset by two Ex. G contra lines, plus other financing -250,000
issues.on_page: Exhibit E reclassifications (150,000.00) on Student transportation - regular and (100,000.00) on Facilities (p6); Exhibit N now prints the exact Capital Assets lines
issues.issue: With the completed Exhibit N the transfer lines are identifiable, so the hidden-transfer rule would split those lines rather than use group contras. Net effect is identical (spending reduced by 250,000, -250,000 other financing, matching the Depreciation Fund's +250,000 on p12), so nothing is double counted.

issues.extracted: no report_discrepancies entry; difference mentioned only in notes; Ex. N total not in detail_totals
issues.on_page: Exhibit N Total Cash Disbursements 11,414,634.69; its program lines sum to 11,414,634.70 (= Exhibit G total, p10)
issues.issue: A 0.01 rounding difference printed in the report itself. The JSON ties to the Ex. G total, so there is no gap, but the discrepancy should be recorded in report_discrepancies (check 'detail', difference -0.01, p25).

In the NDE chart of accounts, Other Purchased Services covers insurance, communication, printing, tuition and travel, not mainly professional services. This is a judgment call; it applies to every Exhibit N 'Other Purchased Services' line (largest: Operation of Buildings 119,123.00, Occupational Therapy 83,439.44, Psych SPED 73,852.57).
'Other Expenses' has no breakdown, so mapping it to dues, training and travel is an assumption (dues and fees are typical but not stated). It applies to every Exhibit N 'Other Expenses' line.

issues.path: detail[Qualified Capital Purpose Undertaking 'Other purchased property services'].detail_category
issues.issue: Purchased property services usually means repairs and maintenance or construction services. land and buildings is defensible for a QCPU fund (the statement counts it under Capital projects), but it is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Row 'Academics & Clubs' under the Receipts / Disbursements columns
issues.issue: The labels add the column name to the printed row label. The amounts are correct; this is only a label mismatch.
